commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 60 --seed 9330 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1200 --ridge 0.1 --run-dir runs/m91d_raw_wheel_observability_formal_seed9330
commands.name: formal_raw_wheel_observability_probe

decision_rule: Compare clean raw-wheel P1 against no-wheel P0 on held-out future envelope targets. Do not train PPO unless P1 gives meaningful and consistent lift.
failure_criteria: formal probe cannot collect episode-disjoint samples
P1 improvements are smaller than the M91-B proxy-wheel result on all targets
results are interpreted as a promoted driver instead of an input-observability gate
hypothesis: A clean raw wheel-state profile contains more deployable self-ID information than the legacy proxy wheel branch, especially for braking and lateral response envelope targets.
success_criteria: formal probe writes samples probe summary profile gains and manifest artifacts
P1 raw wheel improves over P0 on at least two future envelope targets
response-only P1 improves over response-only P0 on at least two future envelope targets
decision explicitly states whether M90 PPO continuation remains blocked
